title: Grateful Dead Live at Feyline Field on 1973-11-25
lineage: MSR> Cass.> DATs> CDRs> EAC> SHN

ai_review.summary: Near‑perfect soundboard capture of a smoking desert show – tight Weather Report Suite, blazing Jerry guitar and high‑energy Dead magic.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as crystal‑clear and virtually flawless for a 1973 soundboard source, with listeners noting the crisp vocals and balanced mix. The performance itself is described as “on fire,” highlighted by an incendiary Weather Report Suite, tight Eyes/Other One transitions, and Jerry’s scorching guitar work throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive 5‑star comments (≈90% of reviews) praise both the musical performance and the technical quality; weighting favors the show, which is repeatedly called a standout, while recording quality is consistently described as near‑perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners cite ‘near perfect’ across the board, crisp vocal clarity and no noticeable dropouts; the Sacks transfer is highlighted as outstanding.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set flows seamlessly with tight transitions—especially the famed China Cat → Rider jam and the Weather Report Suite—creating a cohesive, high‑energy arc.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar is described as ‘on fire’ all night; his vocals are also praised.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for devastating bass feedback at the end of “Playin' in the Band” and ad‑libbed lyrics during “I Know You Rider.”
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals called spirited; remembered for a memorable ‘dig the sunset’ comment.
